description: Parents need to return the permission slip promptly. Parents who want to chaperone need to sign up on the Google Doc provided.

name: PTA Variety Show
description: Parents can volunteer as stage hands or concession organizers. Students can audition to perform.

name: Variety Show Application
description: Do you have a talent to share? Sing, Rap, Dance, Lip Sync, Magic, Musical Instrument, Cheer Performance, Skit, Monologue, Jump Rope, Yo Yo, Puppet show, Comedy Routine, Impressions, Mime, Martial Arts demo, Poetry, Baton twirling. Come show us what you've got! Audition Videos Due by Sunday, March 1st, 2026.

name: Multicultural Fair
description: This year's Multicultural Fair will take place on Friday April 24th from 4-7pm. A beloved tradition at this school, we once again invite you to share your culture with us, whether it's helping with your country's booth (or starting one if it isn't represented yet!), fashion show, or with a group cultural performance.

name: PTA Last Day to Order Yearbook
Yearbook Cover Contest (5th Graders Only)
description: Los Alamitos PTA is inviting all Los Alamitos 5th graders to enter their drawings in our Yearbook cover contest. 2 winners will be selected to be displayed on the front and back cover, by the Yearbook committee panel. Entries due by February 23, 2026.

description: Kindergarten students can wear their pajamas to school.

name: Valentine's Day Celebration
description: Parents need to bring 1 Valentine's card for each of the 22 students in the class, leaving the 'To:' section blank.

description: Parents should send their child in a sports-themed shirt.

name: Variety Show - Volunteers & Important Info
description: We're gearing up for our upcoming Variety Show and need parent volunteers to help make it a success! Volunteer opportunities include Stage Hands and Concession Organizer. We are also looking for a volunteer who can provide a digital keyboard for the event.

name: Nowruz (Iranian New Year) Staff Luncheon
description: Please join us as we treat our staff to a delicious luncheon to celebrate the upcoming Iranian New Year and the first day of spring!

name: 5th Grade Baby Photos for Yearbook
description: 5th grade parents — start gathering those adorable baby photos for the 5th Grade Baby Pages! They are due by March 31st! Please send them to your classroom parent yearbook rep and include your child's full name with the photo.

name: Yearbook Orders
description: Order your 2025–26 Yearbook today and save all the memories. Last day to order: 4/20 — but don't wait until the last minute! We won't have extras on hand if you forget to order.

name: Reading Lab Volunteers Needed
description: The Reading Lab is a tutoring program for students who would benefit from extra help with fundamental reading skills. We are looking for volunteers who can come in once per week (Tuesday, Wednesday, or Thursday) during the school year. Training for new tutors is provided!! Helping these new & growing readers is super fun and rewarding!

name: Incoming 2025/26 Castillero 6th Grade Parents
description: Castillero PTA is looking for incoming 6th grade parents to serve on the board. Castillero PTA funds and/ or runs events and programs like school dances, carnival, spirit wear, teacher and staff appreciation, and teacher grants. If you are interested in getting involved, please contact Stephanie Pearson-Phillips.

name: PTA Board Volunteer Positions for 2026-27
description: We are looking for members of our Los Alamitos community to join our PTA Executive Board for 2026-27 school year! More details about specific positions will be shared soon, but if you're interested in getting involved, please email us or connect with any of our current board members.

name: Dance Volunteer Lead Positions for 2026-27
description: Many of our lead volunteers this year were 5th-grade parents who will be moving on from Los Alamitos next year. As we plan ahead, we are looking for lead volunteers for the 2026–27 school year to help lead our dances. These events do require planning, including booking the DJ nearly a year in advance. The perk? If you choose to be a lead volunteer, you get to pick the dates, choose the theme, and truly work the planning around your schedule.
